lanes.title: Engine CPU cost per system (Bun 1.3.11, JavaScriptCore)
lanes.measures: JS cost per operation of the engine hot paths (ECS, physics, particles, render flush and sort, an integration frame, animation, postfx, tilemap, pathfinding, math), off-device. The draw path runs the real frame renderer against a counting Skia stub, up to the point where a batch is handed to Skia.
doesNotMeasure: Skia rasterization, GPU work, the React Native bridge, or any device.
On-device frame times.
Any JS engine other than JavaScriptCore under Bun: V8, Hermes and SpiderMonkey are not measured.

rows.label: ecs.churn 1000 entities, 5%/step
rows.note: Held to a wider tolerance than every other row (35%, not 10%), and is less reproducible than its neighbours. Two states set by the GC state the row starts from (#480): 50.6-67.6 us (1.34x) over 18 pinned full-suite captures on 2026-11-19, tight when the ECS suite runs alone in a process. Read the spread column, not the median, for this row.

lanes.title: Render submission cost, CanvasKit CPU raster (chromium 159.0.8154.6, CanvasKit)
lanes.measures: Main-thread cost per operation of the 18 render scenarios through real CanvasKit on an offscreen CPU-backed surface, software rasterization included.
doesNotMeasure: GPU-backed rendering.
Browser paint or composite: there is no on-screen canvas in this lane.
Frame rate or frame capacity.

lanes.title: Render submission cost, desktop GPU (chromium 159.0.8154.6, CanvasKit)
lanes.measures: CPU-side submission cost per operation of the 18 render scenarios through real CanvasKit on an on-screen canvas with a WebGL surface.
doesNotMeasure: GPU execution time: WebGL and CanvasKit calls queue work and return, so the clock sees only what the CPU does to build and hand off the frame.
Frame rate or frame capacity.
Other hardware: one desktop machine.

lanes.title: On-device frame rate (React Native + Skia, Hermes)
lanes.statusReason: Captured 2026-04-22 from a bench scene in a game app that now lives in a separate repository. The copy-CSV-from-logcat pipeline that produced these rows no longer exists, so this file cannot be refreshed. Engine-owned device measurement is rebuilt in docs/plans/perf-measurement-2026-07.md §11.7.
lanes.measures: Frames per second, one sample per second, of a bench scene in a React Native game app at three load levels.
doesNotMeasure: The current engine: this is one historical capture that can no longer be refreshed.
Run-to-run spread: it is a single capture.
lanes.note: Release build via `npx expo run:android --variant release`. Hermes enabled. 120 Hz display, uncapped. Bench scene: bullets with random velocities + wall-bounce integration + `coll.step()` per frame; enemies static. Samples = 1/sec, 10s per load.

rows.label: light (10 enemies + 50 bullets)
rows.note: The band is the lowest and highest one-second sample of a single capture, not a run-to-run spread.

counters.title: Draw-path allocation counters (exact)
counters.measures: Exact integers per scenario from the real frame renderer against a counting Skia stub: pool misses, factory calls, and the draw calls and transform writes repeated every frame.
doesNotMeasure: Allocations that pass through neither a pool nor the injected Skia factory.
Time: these are counts, with no run-to-run variance.

heap.title: Integration heap, isolated process per scenario
heap.measures: Median per-frame change of the JavaScriptCore heap footprint over measured blocks, after a warm-up to the allocation plateau. An allocation-pressure proxy.
doesNotMeasure: Retention or live bytes: under JavaScriptCore the figure moves with GC scheduling.
GC pause times, the WASM heap, or device memory.

payload.title: CanvasKit WASM payload
payload.measures: Size on disk of the installed canvaskit-wasm binaries, raw and gzipped.
doesNotMeasure: Brotli size, an application bundle, or the size of any Flare package.

coldStart.title: Cold start to first rendered frame
coldStart.measures: Time from navigation to the first surface flush after CanvasKit loads, in headless Chromium on the offscreen CPU-raster surface.
doesNotMeasure: Browser paint or composite timings: there is no on-screen canvas.
Run-to-run spread: each figure is a single capture.
HTTP cache benefit on the throttled pair: headless Chromium did not serve the WASM from its disk cache in this harness.
Any phone.
